snippet.title: Highway Drifter: Hajwala Simulator Official Trailer!
snippet.description:
We’re so excited to announce that Mad Hook is releasing a brand new hajwala game on PS4 & PS5🔥Our team worked very hard on it so that you can enjoy the best experience ever!🤩 You can now add Highway Drifter: Hajwala Simulator to your wishlist on your Playstation from this link: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009634 
Stay tuned for more details about the release date and don’t forget to tell your friends🚨🚨
